title: Correction to: Ubiquitin Ligases RGLG1 and RGLG5 Regulate Abscisic Acid Signaling by Controlling the Turnover of Phosphatase PP2CA
content: This is a correction to: Qian Wu, Xu Zhang, Marta Peirats-Llobet, Borja Belda-Palazon, Xiaofeng Wang, Shao Cui, Xiangchun Yu, Pedro L.
